research.rule: Stargate production costume and prop references first; no historical WNG apparel

sources.title: Propworx screen-used Wraith male commander costume record (mirrored by Stargate-Fusion)
evidence: Green leather outer garment and black reptile-pattern leather vest.
Front snaps and zipper closures with side/back lacing.
Leather trousers, gauntlets and boots establish the practical Wraith wardrobe material language.

sources.title: Screen-used Wraith commander costume record
evidence: Long vest/jacket construction is primarily soft leather.
Layered textured upper-sleeve/shoulder work and visible production wear.
Lacing and snap construction support a hand-built rather than generic sci-fi finish.

sources.title: Val Halverson Q&A hosted by Joseph Mallozzi
evidence: Wraith costumes were generally three-piece builds using substantial cowhide and contrast leather.
Texture was deliberately important to the costume design.
Later male Wraith differentiation was subtle rather than based on loud rank geometry.

sources.title: Wraith Drone Costume auction context
evidence: Use only as supporting evidence for Wraith undergarment/material construction, not as the everyday-uniform silhouette.

required_visual_language: black reptile-pattern leather central vest and shoulder yoke
dark soft-leather sleeve and side structure
narrow contrast-leather collar and front placket
restrained snaps, zipper and side/back lacing
subtle production wear, creasing, rubbed edges and handmade asymmetry
ordinary caste-neutral wardrobe suitable beneath later armour
